review.evidence: Fixed-block state and matched exact VaultV2 source bound asset-backed mint, fee-share mint and burn/redeem at base block 52095842. Parent mint authority remains inherited. Owner/curator control addresses and selector delays are current; internal authorization closure receives no favorable assumption. Exact implementation creation transaction 0x365e979eb98424e0fcedad75285d1c9ae4cd4be4a3a3841318666316f4082bf7, block 45427904, timestamp 2026-05-01T14:19:15+00:00, was independently joined from Blockscout creation identity to RPC transaction receipt and block timestamp; issuer founding and parent launch were not substituted. Current exact owner-to-Safe, curator-to-Safe and guardian census is recorded. Absence of independent financial assurance is retained in Backing research and is not an unresolved local share-issuance reconciliation question. Separate signer/key-custody observation, recorded per identified control rather than as an aggregate issuance-census gap: Safe signer independence and offchain key-custody attestations are not published; onchain ownership and quorum do not resolve those facts. Calibration v2 field re-justification: reconciliation=not-applicable describes the immutable deposit-backed local share mechanism and does not assert parent reserve-to-total-liability financial assurance; supervision=none grants no prudential-supervision credit. Source-defined share accounting and independent financial assurance retain separate scopes.
